source(output(
		Effective_Date as string,
		Member_ID as string,
		Source_System as string,
		Term_Date as string,
		Member_PCP_ID as string,
		Member_Program as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'Select  LTRIM(RTRIM([Member_ID])) AS [Member_ID] ,LTRIM(RTRIM([Effective_Date])) AS [Effective_Date]	 ,LTRIM(RTRIM([Term_Date])) AS [Term_Date] ,LTRIM(RTRIM([Member_PCP_ID])) AS [Member_PCP_ID] ,LTRIM(RTRIM([Member_Program])) AS [Member_Program] ,LTRIM(RTRIM([Source_System])) AS [Source_System] FROM [EXTRACT].FL_3M_Membership_PCP',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> MembershipPCP
MembershipPCP sink(input(
		Effective_Date as string,
		Member_ID as string,
		Source_System as string,
		Term_Date as string,
		Member_PCP_ID as string,
		Member_Program as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Effective_Date,
		Member_ID,
		Source_System,
		Term_Date,
		Member_PCP_ID,
		Member_Program)) ~> MembershipPCPFIle
